The '''XSISC Semiconductor Plant''' is a high-technology industrial project named in the extracted [[Xanaqu South Industrial State Cooperation]] source.

The source places the plant in XSISC's 1990s modernization phase, alongside automation, telecommunications, foreign partnerships, and expanded high-technology manufacturing.

== 1994-Back Treatment ==

Because the source describes the broader period as 1990-2000, this draft should not assume the plant was complete or fully operational by 1994. For the current porting pass, it is safest to treat the plant as an early-1990s modernization trajectory and possible bridge into the post-1994 wiki pass.

The plant is still useful for 1994-back lore because it shows the direction of Xanaqu's industrial policy before the cutoff: state industry was moving from heavy manufacturing and defense production into electronics and advanced manufacturing.
